intelligence_brief.title: Semiconductor Supply Chain and Critical Mineral Geopolitical Assessment

taiwan.summary: TSMC continues to navigate escalating cross-strait tensions while accelerating M&A activities in Arizona and Germany to mitigate PSIA (Political Supply Interruption Anxiety). Domestic power grid stability remains a primary vulnerability for advanced node production.

japan.summary: The Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) has finalized subsidies for the Kumamoto disk-chip manufacturing hub, signaling a pivot toward domestic self-sufficiency in legacy and mid-range nodes.

united_states.summary: The Department of Commerce is intensifying export controls on high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced lithography equipment to prevent dual-use technology leakage into MOC (Military-Civil Fusion) sectors.

gallium_germanium.summary: Export restrictions from China continue to force downstream manufacturers to seek alternative refining capacity in Southeast Asia and Australia, though cost-parity remains elusive.
